articles.title: Rochdale AFC Plays First Home Game in EFL After Three Years
articles.excerpt: Rochdale AFC returns to the Crown Oil Arena for their first home game in the EFL in three years, with the venue recently refurbished and the National League play-off trophy on display.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale AFC is set to play their first home game in the English Football League (EFL) in three years today, marking a significant milestone for the club and its supporters. The match will take place at the Crown Oil Arena, which has undergone recent renovations in preparation for this momentous occasion.

The Crown Oil Arena has been spruced up, with improvements made to enhance the matchday experience for fans. Notably, the National League play-off trophy will be prominently displayed at the venue, celebrating the club's recent achievements and their return to the EFL.

This home game is particularly important for Rochdale AFC, as it represents a new chapter for the club following their promotion. Fans are expected to turn out in numbers to support their team, eager to witness the action live after a prolonged absence from home fixtures in the league.

As the match kicks off, local supporters will be hoping for a strong performance from their team, setting the tone for the season ahead. The club's return to the EFL is not just a sporting event; it is a significant moment for the community, bringing excitement and pride back to the town.

articles.title: Rochdale AFC Defeated 3-0 by Newport County in League Two Opener
articles.excerpt: Rochdale AFC faced a disappointing start to the Sky Bet League Two season, losing 3-0 to Newport County on the opening day of the campaign.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale AFC suffered a heavy defeat in their opening match of the Sky Bet League Two season, losing 3-0 to Newport County on Saturday, August 22, 2026.

The match took place at Newport's Rodney Parade, where the home side dominated throughout, securing all three points with a convincing performance.

This loss marks a challenging start for Rochdale as they aim to improve upon last season's performance and compete effectively in the league.

Next up for Rochdale AFC is a home fixture, where they will look to bounce back and secure their first points of the season. Fans will be hoping for a stronger showing in their upcoming matches.
